Sofia / Marissa — reviewed NovaCorp's redlines. Attached I uploaded a short redline/clean pair with suggested language (NovaCorp_MSA_draft_v3_redlines.docx, highlights). Summary of proposed approach:

1) Publicity and Reference Rights (combined clause) — Redwood will be allowed to include Customer name and logo in customer lists and marketing materials, provided such use follows the customer's published logo guidelines and is not reasonably likely to imply endorsement.

2) For any press release, case study, or extended customer profile we will request prior written approval from Customer, and Customer will review and respond within 10 business days. If Customer does not respond within 10 business days, Redwood may proceed with prior-notification-only (not silent approval) — but if Customer provided comments, we'll incorporate reasonably.

3) For short testimonial quotes (<=2 sentences), we propose Redwood may use the quote after providing it to Customer for a 10-business-day review; if Customer requests edits, Redwood will pause publication until edits are agreed or escalate to commercial lead.

4) Logo usage will be strictly limited to the attached Logo Guidelines PDF and any usage outside those specs will require explicit written permission.

5) We carved out internal case studies (non-public) for ops/enablement use with the same review window.

I also added a short indemnity carve that logos/marks usage does not create any implied endorsement beyond the typical customer relationship and requires compliance with trademark attribution.

If that aligns with marketing/SDR needs, I can send to NovaCorp with a brief cover note.

Attachments: NovaCorp_MSA_draft_v3_redlines.docx (Redwood_legal_v1)

Kimberly Park
